uncertainty_bound_proof: Each nonzero compiled connection term increases epsilon offset by at least 1. With N retained offsets, any product of N such matrices is zero independently of time ordering or commutativity of physical blocks. A fixed positive diagonal source scaling preserves this block structure. Bounding the j-fold ordered integration simplex by L^j/j! yields the finite sum through N-1. Any exact nonzero M0 retains exp(L).
